question: Who were the defending champions at the 15th Hockey India Senior Women National Championship 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Hockey Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hockey Jharkhand** emerged as the defending champions at the **15th Hockey India Senior Women National Championship 2025**.
 
• They secured the championship title in the **previous edition of the tournament** held in 2024, showcasing their dominance in women's hockey.
 
• The team is known for its **exceptional players**, many of whom hail from the tribal regions of Jharkhand, an area known for producing talented hockey players.
 
• Jharkhand has a strong hockey culture and infrastructure, which has contributed to the **development of skilled players** and consistent performance in national-level tournaments.
 
• The team’s success is also attributed to the **state government's support** and initiatives in promoting hockey, especially among women.
 
• Hockey Jharkhand's victory highlights the growing prominence of **women’s hockey** in India, with teams from various states striving for excellence.

__
 
• **Hockey Haryana**__

 __
 
• **Hockey Haryana** is one of the top-performing teams in national hockey tournaments, with a strong track record in both men’s and women’s categories.
 
• The state has produced numerous players for the **Indian national hockey team**, thanks to its excellent training facilities and grassroots programs.
 
• Despite their strong performances, they were not the defending champions in the 15th edition of the tournament.
 
 
 
• **Hockey Punjab**__
 __
 
• **Hockey Punjab** is renowned for its contributions to Indian hockey, producing legendary players over the years.
 
• The state has a deep-rooted hockey culture, often excelling in men’s hockey but also showing significant improvement in women’s hockey in recent years.
 
• However, they did not win the championship title in 2024, making them ineligible as defending champions in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Hockey Maharashtra**__
 
 
• **Hockey Maharashtra** has been striving to improve its performance in national tournaments, focusing on youth development and training programs.
 
• The team has shown potential but has yet to achieve consistent success at the national level, including the Hockey India Senior Women National Championship.
